# NGINX — custom-to-root-context-sse

NGINX proxy at /app/, app at root /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The proxy strips the /app prefix before forwarding to the backend root.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

NGINX template (`nginx/http/custom-to-root-context-sse/default.conf.template`):

```nginx
# SSE-only proxy: no `map $http_upgrade`, no Upgrade/Connection headers — this
# config deliberately cannot upgrade a connection. Vaadin PUSH still works
# because SSE is an ordinary HTTP GET that streams text/event-stream, and the
# client-to-server messages are XHR POSTs to the same path.
#
# proxy_http_version 1.1 + proxy_buffering off are what make the stream flow:
# with buffering left on (the default) nginx holds every event until its buffer
# fills. proxy_read_timeout covers the 60s PUSH heartbeat.

server {

    listen       80;
    server_name  localhost;

    location /app/ {
        proxy_set_header        Host $host;
        proxy_set_header        X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header        X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header        X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        proxy_http_version      1.1;
        proxy_buffering         off;
        proxy_read_timeout      300s;

        proxy_pass http://vaadin:8080/;
        proxy_redirect $scheme://$host/ $scheme://$http_host/app/;
        proxy_cookie_path / /app;
    }
}
```
